_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY -- copy this file to offer_config.json and replace every field with your real business details. draft.py refuses to run on unfilled placeholder text.
what_you_sell: onboarding software that gets new B2B SaaS customers to their first value moment in days instead of weeks
icp_description: B2B SaaS companies with 20-200 employees who are actively scaling their sales or customer success team

proof_points.detail: for a 40-person sales org at a Series B SaaS company

proof_points.claim: reduced support tickets by 30% in the first 90 days

cta_style: soft, interest-based question (e.g. 'worth a look?') -- never a hard meeting-time ask in email 1, no calendar link until the recipient shows interest
_example_emails_comment: OPTIONAL. Hand-write 1-3 real emails you'd be proud to send, purely as a tone/structure reference for the model -- useful on day one, before Stage 10's feedback loop has any real replies to learn from. The facts inside these are NEVER reused for a real lead, only the style. Delete this whole key if you don't want it.

example_emails.subject: quick question
example_emails.body: Saw you just opened a new office in Austin -- always a sign of real momentum. We help companies like yours cut onboarding time in half during exactly this kind of growth phase. Worth a look?
